in_marathi.name: Shrivansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Shiva's boon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shrivansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shrivansh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vansh', meaning 'progeny'. The prefix 'Shri' is an honorific prefix used to denote respect and reverence towards the deity Lord Shiva. Thus, the name Shrivansh signifies 'Lord Shiva's boon' or 'blessings'.

The prefix 'Shri' is an honorific prefix used to denote respect and reverence towards the deity Lord Shiva. Thus, the name Shrivansh signifies 'Lord Shiva's boon' or 'blessings'.
